facts.text: The hotel is in Edinburgh's Old Town, just off the Royal Mile.
facts.excerpt: Our boutique 5-star hotel is situated just off the Royal Mile in Edinburgh's Old Town

facts.text: The hotel is at 1 India Buildings on Victoria Street.
facts.excerpt: Turn left on to Victoria Street and you will find the hotel on your left-hand side at 1 India Buildings.

facts.text: From the hotel's red door guests can stroll down Victoria Street or explore Edinburgh Castle.
facts.excerpt: Step out of our red door and take a stroll down Victoria Street, explore Edinburgh Castle

facts.text: Some rooms have views of Edinburgh Castle.
facts.excerpt: From views of Edinburgh Castle and regal lounge areas, to walk-in showers and sit-down makeup vanities, we have somewhere for everyone.

facts.text: Rooms with a balcony look out over Edinburgh's Old Town.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the vibrant Edinburgh Old Town right from your private space.

facts.text: Rooms have SMEG fridges stocked at street prices.
facts.excerpt: Our signature SMEG fridges are smartly stocked at street prices, so you won't be paying a premium for the convenience.

facts.text: A yoga mat is available in every chamber.
facts.excerpt: roll out your yoga mat (available in every chamber)

facts.text: Discreet partitions separate the sleeping quarters from the dressing room.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy your privacy with discreet partitions separating the sleeping quarters from the dressing room.

facts.text: Rooms have a dedicated makeup vanity and dressing area with flattering lights.
facts.excerpt: take a seat at our dedicated makeup vanity and dressing area. Fitted with flattering lights

facts.text: Suites come with a complimentary mini-bar.
facts.excerpt: some unexpected delights (like a complimentary mini-bar!)

facts.text: The Oculus Lounge is an elegant circular lounge below a historic cupola.
facts.excerpt: an elegant circular lounge located below a historic cupola

facts.text: Commons Club serves Scottish fare with international flair.
facts.excerpt: Scottish fare, served with international flair.

facts.text: Eve is an Italian restaurant and bar.
facts.excerpt: head to Eve Restaurant and Bar, where vibrant Italian dishes come to life in a relaxed, contemporary setting

facts.text: The Scottish Table serves ten dishes across three courses of seasonal Scottish ingredients in the Commons Club Kitchen for up to 10 people at a time.
facts.excerpt: Ten dishes served across three courses bring together seasonal Scottish ingredients at their best, served in our intimate Commons Club Kitchen for up to 10 people at a time.

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served daily, at weekends in the Oculus Lounge.
facts.excerpt: served Monday to Friday in our Commons Club Bar, and at weekends in the enchanting Oculus Lounge

facts.text: The hotel is dog friendly and pets stay free.
facts.excerpt: And as an added treat, pets stay free!

facts.text: The hotel has a gym and fitness centre.
facts.excerpt: Walk, jog or run down to our gym and fitness centre.

facts.text: The Virgin Hotels app connects guests' phones to the chamber controls and hotel staff.
facts.excerpt: It connects your mobile device to your chamber controls and hotel staff for a personalized stay.

facts.text: Wi-Fi is free with no hidden charges.
facts.excerpt: All the Wi-Fi, all the time. Watch, play, call or scroll to your heart's content. With no hidden charges.

facts.text: The hotel is about 30 minutes from the airport and an 8-minute walk from the nearest train station.
facts.excerpt: Just 30 minutes from the airport and a short 8-minute walk from the nearest train station

facts.text: From the Princes Street tram stop it is a short walk up a big hill to the hotel.
facts.excerpt: hop off at Princes Street and it’s a short walk up a big hill to the hotel.

facts.text: Drivers reach the main entrance on Victoria Street from George IV Bridge.
facts.excerpt: Our main entrance on Victoria Street can be accessed from George IV Bridge.

facts.text: The hotel hosts weddings and has event venues.
facts.excerpt: Tie the knot in style at Virgin Hotels Edinburgh.

facts.text: The hotel was voted #4 Best Hotel in the United Kingdom in the Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2025.
facts.excerpt: Voted Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2025

facts.text: The hotel says it puts a new spin on Old Town charm.
facts.excerpt: We've put a new spin on Old Town charm at our 5 star luxury hotel in Edinburgh's city centre.
